items.title: Snappier Swipes
items.subtitle: Swipe navigation settles with Apollo's original easing again after you lift your finger.

items.title: Comments Fixes
items.subtitle: The jump button advances on every tap again, and posts opened from highlights or links respect the subreddit's suggested sort.

items.title: Crash Fixes
items.subtitle: Fixes for launch crashes on TrollStore, profile switching, multireddit expansion, LiveContainer, and a Liquid Glass display crash.

items.title: Pill Stays Expanded
items.subtitle: The Liquid Glass action pill stays expanded again; turn on Collapse Navigation Actions if you preferred the collapsing one.

items.title: Hide Header on Scroll
items.subtitle: Let the navigation bar follow the tab bar as it hides, and pick Hidden as a Header Style again.

items.title: Media & Menu Fixes
items.subtitle: Videos stay audible after rotating, adding to a multireddit no longer reports an error, and the ⋯ sheet gets along with other tweaks.
